bio_text: Haibo Zhao is a robotics researcher and PhD student affiliated with the Helping Hands Lab at Northeastern University, working on robot manipulation, equivariant policy learning, and data-efficient imitation learning. He has published at top venues including CoRL 2024, RAL, and IJRR, with a focus on geometric deep learning applied to robotic manipulation. His LinkedIn activity highlights a strong conviction that structured, hierarchical approaches to robot learning can dramatically reduce data requirements.
